paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
notes: This is a model-independent dark matter search using Breakthrough Listen data (1020-2700 MHz, L and S bands). The paper reports limits on generic dark matter annihilation cross-section (⟨σv⟩ ≈ 10⁻³⁰ cm³/s) and decay constant (λ ≈ 10⁻³² s⁻¹), not on specific particle physics couplings like g_aγγ or other canonical variables. The search is designed to detect quasimonochromatic radio lines from any ultralight bosonic dark matter through decay or annihilation to photons, without assuming a specific particle model or coupling mechanism. Figure 9 shows the resulting limits as functions of frequency. This does not constitute a new measured limit on one of the canonical axion or dark matter coupling planes.
